single.rationale: Kforce faces sustained revenue headwinds (three consecutive years of decline, -8.1% 3-year CAGR) driven by macro uncertainty and AI-related hesitancy, though sequential Q4 2025 improvement (+3% billing-day basis) and expanding solutions-oriented engagements suggest potential stabilization. The company maintains strong FCF generation (7.2% yield) and aggressive capital return (>100% of operating cash flow), but deteriorating margins (operating margin compressed to 3.8% from 6.9% in 2022) and shrinking equity base raise concerns about sustainability during prolonged weakness.
